lines.en: label mayachristmalloween3:
scene mayalovehotel1
I’ll close my eyes and recall this room and everything in it.
lines.zh: 我会闭上眼睛，回想这间房，以及房里的一切。

lines.en: My body is estrangement. This desire, perfection. Your closed eyes my extinction.
lines.zh: 我的身体是疏离。这份欲望，是完美。你闭着的眼睛，是我的消亡。

lines.en: Now I’ve forgotten my idea.
lines.zh: 现在，我忘了我的念头了。

lines.en: The book on the windowsill, riffled by the wind...the even-numbered pages are the past. The odd-numbered pages, the future. The sun is God. Your body is milk.
lines.zh: 窗台上那本被风翻动的书……偶数页是过去。奇数页，是未来。太阳是神。你的身体是牛奶。

lines.en: Useless, useless...Your cries are song, my body’s not me.
lines.zh: 没用，没用……你的哭喊是歌，我的身体不是我。

lines.en: No good...my idea has evaporated. Your hair is time, your thighs are song.
lines.zh: 不行……我的念头蒸发了。你的头发是时间，你的大腿是歌。

lines.en: It had something to do with death.
lines.zh: 它跟死亡有关。

lines.en: It had something to do with love.
lines.zh: 它跟爱有关。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone1
: Okay...break time.
lines.zh: : 好了……休息时间。

lines.en: : Next round, I get to be the sub.
lines.zh: : 下一轮，轮到我当受。

lines.en: : You overestimate my sexual prowess. I think I’m done for the day.
lines.zh: : 你高估我的性能力了。我想我今天到此为止了。

lines.en: : They say you become a master of something once you’ve spent about 10,000 hours doing it. By that alone, I think it’s pretty safe to say our prowess can not be overestimated.
lines.zh: : 据说一件事做满一万小时就能成大师。光凭这一点，我想我们的「能力」根本不可能被高估。

lines.en: : And that’s not even counting however many hours you spent wasting energy on lesser things.
lines.zh: : 而且那还没算上你浪费在次等东西上的那些小时。

lines.en: : Still, there are limits to what the human body is capable of.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，可人类的身体终归有极限。

lines.en: : Sure. But we haven’t found them yet, and I don’t think a single night of hot reunion sex is the big revelation you need to finally scribe a finite limit.
lines.zh: : 当然。但我们还没找到那个极限，而且我不觉得一夜火热的重逢性爱，就能让你终于写下一条有限的界线。

lines.en: : Are you happy here, Maya?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿开心吗，Maya？

lines.en: : What, in a love hotel? I guess so. So long as you’re the one who took me.
lines.zh: : 什么，在爱情旅馆？大概吧。只要是带我来的那个人是你就行。

lines.en: : I don’t know how to be vulnerable with anybody else.
lines.zh: : 我不知道怎么对别人卸下防备。

lines.en: : I believe that. You barely know how to do it with me.
lines.zh: : 我相信。你对我都几乎做不到。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone2
: You’ve barely given me the chance to. But the truth is you could get anything out of me right now by simply asking.
lines.zh: : 那是你几乎没给过我机会。但说实话，你只要开口，我现在什么都能给你。

lines.en: : Post-nut clarity hits you hard, huh?
lines.zh: : 射精后的清醒对你打击挺大啊，是吧？

lines.en: : Sure does. Either that or I just feel at home when you hold me like this.
lines.zh: : 可不是。要么就是因为，你这样抱着我的时候，我感觉像回了家。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone3
: So my answer to that too is yes — I am happy here. So long as “here” is with you. Similar to the love hotel answer, but cuter and designed to make you fall deeper in love with me.
lines.zh: : 所以那个问题的答案也是「是」——我在这里是开心的。只要「这里」是跟你一起。跟爱情旅馆那个答案差不多，但更可爱，就是为了让你更深地爱上我。

lines.en: : And if the question was about Kumon-mi and not something more on the micro level like a love hotel or a hug?
lines.zh: : 那如果问题是关于 Kumon-mi，而不是爱情旅馆或者拥抱这种更微观的东西呢？

lines.en: : Well, then my answer changes entirely. Because I’ve learned in recent times to despise this place.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我的答案就完全变了。因为最近这段时间，我学会了厌恶这个地方。

lines.en: : I hate its walls. I hate its people. I hate its affinity for disrupting every single moment of peace with one more demonstration of how it’s different. Or scary. I hate that it hates me.
lines.zh: : 我恨它的墙。我恨它的人。我恨它那种癖好——总要用下一场「它与众不同」或「它很可怕」的演示，把每一刻安宁都搅碎。我恨它恨我。

lines.en: : And so of course I wouldn’t be happy in a place like that.
lines.zh: : 所以，我当然不会在那种地方开心。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone4
: How about you? You know, now that we’ve entered the feelings and discussion state of sexual intercourse.
lines.zh: : 那你呢？你知道，既然我们已经进入了性爱的「聊感受」阶段。

lines.en: : My answer changes all the time. I think Kumon-mi could do without all those paranormal demonstrations as well. And it’d be nice being able to leave, for sure.
lines.zh: : 我的答案一直在变。我觉得 Kumon-mi 也完全可以不要那些灵异演示。当然，能离开也不错。

lines.en: : “But this is the place where I met you, Maya. So I could never truly hate it.”
lines.zh: : 「但这是我遇见你的地方，Maya。所以我永远不会真的恨它。」

lines.en: scene mayapostbone5
: Sure. That sounded better than what I was going to say, so let’s just go with that.
lines.zh: : 行。那话比我本来想说的好听，我们就当是那么说的吧。

lines.en: : You were going to say exactly that, you sappy deviant. That was a direct quote I just happened to memorize because of how happy it made me.
lines.zh: : 你本来就是要那么说的，你这个伤感的变态。那是一句原话，我恰好背下来了——因为它让我太开心了。

lines.en: : So you knew what I was asking all along and just pretended not to. Typical Maya.
lines.zh: : 所以你一开始就知道我在问什么，只是装不知道。真是典型的 Maya。

lines.en: : And you were too entranced by the recent sensation of being choked by a little girl to remember that we’ve already had this talk before. Typical Akira.
lines.zh: : 而你被刚才「被一个小女孩掐住脖子」的感觉迷得神魂颠倒，都忘了这场对话我们已经进行过了。真是典型的 Akira。

lines.en: : Sorry, but I think I’m going to have a hard time seeing you as “a little girl” after everything you said to me tonight. Any innocence you had to you is now permanently lost. How sad.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过听了你今晚对我说的所有话之后，我想我很难再把你当成「小女孩」了。你身上曾经有过的任何纯真，现在都永久地消失了。真可惜。

lines.en: : In my defense, how could I have any innocence left after giving it all to you?
lines.zh: : 为自己辩护一下：我把所有纯真都给了你之后，怎么可能还剩得下？

lines.en: scene mayapostbone6
: So, how far back can you remember exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么，你到底能往前记到多远？

lines.en: : Why do you ask? Is there a certain memory or situation you’d like me act out? Because, if that’s the case, I might need about an hour to run back to the dorm and grab my old randoseru.
lines.zh: : 为什么这么问？是有什么特定的记忆或情境，你想让我演出来吗？因为如果是那样，我大概需要一个小时跑回宿舍拿我的旧书包。

lines.en: : Not that. There’s just a lot that’s still not really there for me. But whether that’s due to emotional suppression or just Kumon-mi’s regular antics, I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 不是那个。只是有很多事对我来说还是空白的。但那是因为情绪压抑，还是 Kumon-mi 惯常的把戏，我不知道。

lines.en: : Could be either, really. You weren’t exactly super enthusiastic in the beginning. Which made sense considering your weird mom-girlfriend thing was still in the process of decomposing.
lines.zh: : 说真的，两个都可能。你一开始确实没那么热情。考虑到你那个奇怪的「妈妈女友」还在分解过程中，这也说得通。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone7
: And also how your other girlfriend needed to be left behind for her sake or yours or however it was you worded it back then. I try to purge all Niki-centric memories, to be fair. So who knows?
lines.zh: : 还有，你的另一个女朋友必须被留下——是为她好还是为你好，随你当年怎么措辞。公平地说，我尽量把所有关于 Niki 的记忆都清除掉。所以谁知道呢？

lines.en: : How did this start then? Could you tell me that at least?
lines.zh: : 那这一切是怎么开始的？至少这个你能告诉我吧？

lines.en: scene mayapostbone8
: Really capitalizing on that vulnerability thing, huh? Do I get a reward for telling you?
lines.zh: : 真是把「卸下防备」这件事利用到极致啊，是吧？告诉你有奖励吗？

lines.en: : Is it truly vulnerability if you need to be bribed to let it out?
lines.zh: : 如果需要贿赂才肯说出来，那还算真的卸下防备吗？

lines.en: : I don’t need to be. I’d just like to be. It’s different.
lines.zh: : 我不需要被贿赂。我只是想被贿赂。这不一样。

lines.en: : You can just say you don’t remember, Maya.
lines.zh: : 你可以直接说你不记得，Maya。

lines.en: : And lie? I don’t lie to you, Sensei. I’m not your daughter.
lines.zh: : 然后撒谎？我不对你撒谎，老师。我不是你女儿。

lines.en: : What does Ami lie to me about?
lines.zh: : Ami 对我撒什么谎？

lines.en: : What doesn’t Ami lie to you about? For all you know, she might be the one who can answer all of your questions. Not me.
lines.zh: : Ami 有什么不对你撒谎的？说不定能回答你所有问题的人就是她，不是我。

lines.en: : What’s the matter? That strike a nerve?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？戳到痛处了？

lines.en: : Yeah, I...
: Ayane and I...remember something about her too. About how she’s just as involved in all of this as you. Ayane says she denied it, though.
lines.zh: : Ayane 和我……也想起了一些关于她的事。关于她跟你一样深地卷进这一切。不过 Ayane 说她否认了。

lines.en: : Ooooh?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦？

lines.en: : What? If you know something, say it.
lines.zh: : 什么？你知道什么就说。

lines.en: : Really capitalizing on that vulnerability thing, huh? Do I get a reward for telling you?
lines.zh: : 真是把「卸下防备」这件事利用到极致啊，是吧？告诉你有奖励吗？

lines.en: : Are we just going in circles now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在是在原地打转吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. I’m far too horny to handle two massive questions at once. You need to be gentle with me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。我太欲火中烧了，没法同时处理两个巨大的问题。你得对我温柔点，老师。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone9
: Emotionally, at least. Physically, I can take whatever kind of beating you’re brave enough to give me.
lines.zh: : 至少在情绪上。身体上，你敢给我什么我都受得住。

lines.en: : Then...start with the first question since the last one is going to wind up making me sad and I know you want to have more sex.
lines.zh: : 那么……先从第一个问题开始，因为最后一个会让我难过，而我知道你还想再来。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone8
: How do you know the first question won’t wind up making you sad too? Because it’s not exactly a happy story. Even with all of the orgasms and...anatomical exploration.
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道第一个问题不会也让你难过？因为那可不是什么开心的故事。就算有那么多次高潮和……解剖学上的探索。

lines.en: : I’m not saying it won’t. I’m just at a point now where it’s becoming easier to look back on the past than toward the future.
lines.zh: : 我没说它不会。我只是到了这么一个阶段：回头看过去，比看向未来更容易。

lines.en: : Since the future is scary? Or since the future won’t ever come?
lines.zh: : 因为未来很可怕？还是因为未来永远不会来？

lines.en: : It will come...I’ll make sure of it.
lines.zh: : 它会来的……我会确保它来。

lines.en: : Oooh? And since when are you so serious about making your dreams come true?
lines.zh: : 哦哦？你什么时候开始这么认真地要让梦想成真了？

lines.en: : It’s less of a dream and more of a...mission, I guess. And it’s new.
lines.zh: : 与其说是梦想，不如说是一个……使命吧，我想。而且是新冒出来的。

lines.en: : But it feels like there’s something waiting for me there. And that it’s suddenly more important than ever before to try and get to the bottom of this.
lines.zh: : 但感觉那儿有什么东西在等我。而且把这一切查个水落石出，突然变得比以往任何时候都重要。

lines.en: : Well, I hope that for your sake, you fail.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我希望为了你自己，你失败。

lines.en: : What? What’s that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 什么？那是什么意思？

lines.en: : Well, I’m not going anywhere. And despite how hot I will inevitably be when I am fully grown,  I know you’re going to miss what I am now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我哪儿都不会去。而且尽管我长大之后无可避免地会变得很辣，我知道你会怀念现在的我。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone10
: I guess that’s something I can get used to, though. I mean, I’ve already accepted that you miss the even younger me too, so...
lines.zh: : 不过我想那是我可以习惯的事。我是说，我已经接受了你也怀念更小的我这件事，所以……

lines.en: : I think it’s less about the stage of your development and more that it’s just you, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这跟你的发育阶段关系不大，更多的是——那就是你，Maya。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone11
: Professional groomer talk. Nice. It’s certainly no mystery how you bagged me when you can pull lines like that out of your back pocket.
lines.zh: : 专业驯化师话术。漂亮。你能从后兜里掏出这种话，难怪能把我拿下。

lines.en: : Maya-
lines.zh: : Maya——

lines.en: scene mayapostbone12
: You know, maybe I was just vulnerable back then too...but I didn’t really have any second thoughts about your intentions when you took me in.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许我那时候也只是很脆弱……可你收留我的时候，我对你的意图真的没有任何怀疑。

lines.en: : Took you in? So we-
lines.zh: : 收留你？那我们——

lines.en: : It might sound weird, but the earliest memory I have is waking up in the rain and finding you right there in front of me.
lines.zh: : 听起来可能很奇怪，但我最早的记忆是在雨里醒来，发现你就站在我面前。

lines.en: : I remember how massive your hand was when you crouched down to offer it to me. How it looked like you’d been crying, even with how fogged up your glasses were.
lines.zh: : 我记得你蹲下来把手递给我的时候，那只手有多大。也记得就算你的眼镜全被雾气蒙住了，你看起来还是像刚哭过。

lines.en: : There was sunlight too — peeking out from the clouds. And it honestly seemed like you were some sort of angel, rescuing me from whatever it was that came before.
lines.zh: : 还有阳光——从云缝里探出来。而你真的像某种天使，把我从之前的一切里救了出来。

lines.en: : So of course I followed you. I trusted you with everything in that moment.
lines.zh: : 所以我当然就跟着你走了。那一刻我把一切都托付给了你。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone13
: Though, I’d be lying if I said I didn’t immediately start questioning myself when the first place you dragged me to was a creepy and seemingly abandoned apartment complex.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果你说你把我拖到的第一个地方是一间阴森的、看似废弃的公寓楼时我没有立刻开始怀疑自己，那是撒谎。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : It was furnished at least. Well...kind of. And I guess it still had power too since you had a computer there and everything.
lines.zh: : 至少有家具。嗯……算有。而且我想还通着电，因为你那儿有台电脑什么的。

lines.en: : There was only one bed, though. So I kind of assumed we’d be sleeping together and, while I wasn’t exactly opposed given the circumstances, you ran out and bought me a futon that same day.
lines.zh: : 不过只有一张床。所以我大概默认我们得睡一起——虽然考虑到当时的情况我也不算反对，但你当天就跑出去给我买了一床被褥。

lines.en: : You’d feed me. Buy me clothes. Teach me all sorts of stuff about literature or poetry or any other pretentious bullshit that would help keep you distracted.
lines.zh: : 你会喂我。给我买衣服。教我各种各样关于文学、诗歌，或者任何能让你分心的装腔作势的玩意儿。

lines.en: : But I could tell you were in pain. So I’d ask about it and you’d just shrug me off.
lines.zh: : 可我能看出来你很痛苦。所以我会问你，而你只是把我打发开。

lines.en: : The thing is, I get jealous easily. And there was another girl who would come around that you were a lot more open with. One you knew for longer.
lines.zh: : 问题是，我很容易吃醋。而当时还有另一个女孩常来，你对她要坦诚得多。一个你认识得更久的人。

lines.en: : Combine that with how you’d never spend the night and always come back the next day smelling like strawberries, and I couldn’t help but feel like you were starting to phase me out.
lines.zh: : 再加上你从不在那儿过夜，第二天回来总是一身草莓味，我忍不住觉得你是不是开始要把我淡出去了。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone14
: Which, uhh...may have led to a little emotional breakdown you needed to quell by telling me you had a niece at home you were looking after. Soooo...that made me feel like an idiot.
lines.zh: : 而那，呃……可能就导致了一次小小的情绪崩溃，你不得不告诉我你在家还要照顾一个侄女，才把它压下去。所以……那让我觉得自己像个白痴。

lines.en: : But why wouldn’t I just introduce you to Ami then? Why would I hide you away in some random apartment thing if you were just some girl I was looking after?
lines.zh: : 可我为什么不直接把你介绍给 Ami？如果你只是我在照顾的某个女孩，我为什么要把你藏在某个莫名其妙的公寓里？

lines.en: scene mayapostbone15
: Maybe you wanted me to be more? Maybe the intention really was to turn me into a sex slave that you could just hide away? Only you knew your motivations, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 也许你想让我成为更多？也许你的本意真的是把我变成一个可以藏起来的性奴？只有你知道你当年的动机，老师。

lines.en: : Well, what do you think they were? Because you clearly know more about me back then than I do. This entire part of my life is just...blank.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那你自己觉得是什么？因为你显然比我还了解当年的我。我人生的这一整段完全是……空白。

lines.en: : If you asked me back then, I’d have answered with something along the lines of you just wanting to care for a little girl who was down on her luck.
lines.zh: : 如果你当年问我，我会回答说：你只是想照顾一个走投无路的小女孩。

lines.en: : But I’m not asking you back then. I’m asking you now.
lines.zh: : 可我不是问当年的你。我在问现在的你。

lines.en: : You are. But I’m supposed to prevent you from getting sad if I want to have more sex. And the current answer makes you seem like kind of a bad guy.
lines.zh: : 是。但如果我还想继续做爱，我就得防着你难过。而现在的答案会让你显得有点像个坏人。

lines.en: : So...when did we start...you know...
lines.zh: : 所以……我们是从什么时候开始……你知道的……

lines.en: : You really want to know?
lines.zh: : 你真想知道？

lines.en: : I think I just need to hear it. Because I can’t really understand how we’d go from how you’re making it sound to...whatever this is.
lines.zh: : 我想我只是需要听到。因为我实在无法理解，我们怎么从你描述的那样，变成了……现在这种东西。

lines.en: : This is love, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这就是爱，不是吗？

lines.en: : Is it? Can love really be born from something so fucked up?
lines.zh: : 是吗？爱真的能从这么操蛋的东西里长出来吗？

lines.en: : It changes with the light. Depends on who you ask.
lines.zh: : 它随光线而变。取决于你问谁。

lines.en: : Besides, you fell in love with Ami’s mom, didn’t you? Isn’t that just you being in my position?
lines.zh: : 再说，你不是也爱上了 Ami 的妈妈吗？那不就跟你站在我这个位置上是一样的？

lines.en: : It is. But I’m old enough now to understand that, despite my feelings, that shouldn’t have happened.
lines.zh: : 是。可我现在年纪够大了，明白那种事不管我有什么感情，本就不该发生。

lines.en: : Yet here we lie, naked in a love hotel as you recollect these lessons in love just to immediately forget them. Oh, how times never change at all.
lines.zh: : 而我们此刻还裸躺在爱情旅馆里，你追忆着这些「爱的一课」，就为了转头再把它们忘掉。哦，时间真是一点都没变。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone16
: It was me.
lines.zh: : 是我。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : I started it.
lines.zh: : 是我先开始的。

lines.en: : I confessed to you in winter. I wanted to be more. I wanted to help protect the person who’d taken me in.
lines.zh: : 那年冬天，我向你告白了。我想成为更多。我想帮忙保护那个收留了我的人。

lines.en: : And I knew that person was lonely. That person wouldn’t ever hurt someone like Ami or Noriko. People he’d known forever.
lines.zh: : 而我知道那个人很孤独。那个人永远不会伤害 Ami 或 Noriko 那样的人。那些他认识了很久的人。

lines.en: : But if a random girl with no back story mysteriously showed up one day and offered to be his outlet, perhaps he’d take her up on the offer?
lines.zh: : 可如果一个没有过去的陌生女孩某天神秘地出现，主动提出当他的出口，他也许会接受？

lines.en: scene mayapostbone17
: You thought about it for weeks. So long that I assumed you were just going to ignore it and never give me a proper answer.
lines.zh: : 你考虑了好几个星期。久到我以为你干脆不打算理会，永远不会给我一个正式的答复。

lines.en: : But one day, you took me outside to see the snow. Something I’d never seen before.
lines.zh: : 可有一天，你带我出去看雪。那是我从没见过的东西。

lines.en: : And I don’t know if I just looked too cute in the clothes you bought me or if the excitement on my face made you want to corrupt me...but you gave me an answer. And it was the one I wanted.
lines.zh: : 我不知道是不是你给我买的衣服让我看起来太可爱，还是我脸上的兴奋让你想要玷污我……但你给了我一个答复。而正是我想要的那个。

lines.en: : It was like my heart stopped. Like everything I’d ever wanted was finally mine.
lines.zh: : 就像心脏停跳了。好像我这辈子想要的一切，终于都是我的了。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone18
: And the rest is history. Or at least the makings of it.
lines.zh: : 剩下的就是历史了。或者至少是历史的开端。

lines.en: : But our story is far from over, Sensei. And I’m never going to stop making you take responsibility for me after making me me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 但我们的故事还远没有结束，老师。而且我永远不会停止让你为我负责——因为当初是你让我成为「我」的。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone19
: If anything else, I hope you get it now. Why I chase after you so desperately.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，我希望你现在明白了。明白我为什么这么拼命地追你。

lines.en: : I just don’t know anything else.
lines.zh: : 我只是不知道别的活法。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone20
: And also, I am insatiable and conditioned to respond to your touch. It’s hard again.
lines.zh: : 还有，我贪得无厌，而且被调教成对你的触碰有反应。它又硬了。

lines.en: : I know that look. Break time is over, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我认识那个眼神。休息时间结束了，是吧？

lines.en: : Sure is. You’re not the only one who needs to be taking responsibility, Sensei. That is a job for Maya Makinami.
lines.zh: : 可不是。需要负责任的也不只有你，老师。那是牧浪 Maya 的工作。

lines.en: scene mayapostbone21
: Your Maya Makinami.
lines.zh: : 你的牧浪 Maya。

lines.en: : The girl who would not exist at all if it were not for you.
lines.zh: : 一个如果不是因为你，就根本不会存在的女孩。

lines.en: : And...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: scene black
: The luckiest girl in the whole entire world.
lines.zh: : 全世界最幸运的女孩。
